title: CodeReviewReport
description: Output contract for the code-review skill. Emitted as YAML. Use | block scalars for multi-line values.

scope.description: Reviewed target—file path, PR, commit, or diff description.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest printed by scripts/fingerprint.sh; a repeat run seeds its ledger from this report only on a match.

model.description: Review model grounded in ORIENT: runtime execution model, threat model, and trusted inputs. Filters findings in every category; a repeat run inherits it on a fingerprint match.

result.description: Overall review outcome: Issues Found (any non-inherited finding), No New Issues (inherited findings only), No Issues (no findings), or Failed.

verdict.description: Merge verdict derived from findings. Omit on a Failed result.

impact.description: One-sentence impact statement. Omit on a No Issues result.

actions.description: Terse list of review actions taken.

findings.description: Defects found, sorted by severity: Critical → High → Medium → Low → Nit.

signature.description: Defect signature category:path:line-or-range:short-defect-slug, one per root cause, anchored at its primary site; keys ledger deduplication across runs.

severity.description: Severity ranked by likelihood × user impact, or exploitability for security; Low at most for self-recovering, fallback-only, or rerun-cleared defects.

excerpt.description: Quoted code excerpt supporting the finding.

finding.description: One sentence stating the defect, naming sibling sites of a shared root cause.

trigger.description: Trigger passing the evidence threshold: concrete, plausible input or state, reachable code path, and material impact.

guidance.description: Advisory fix hints per references/outcome-guide.md ## Guidance; consumers weigh them on their merits, then accept, partially accept, or ignore them.

pattern.description: Existing exemplar to mirror—path:line and symbol.

solution.description: Concrete, targeted fix sketch naming key sites and steps—never vague advice, a diff, or a full patch.

avoid.description: Tempting wrong fix the finding invites—such as a suppression, a masking guard, or a weakened type—with why it fails.

tests.description: Regression test hint: test file to extend, fixtures to reuse, triggering case.

suppressed_findings.description: Findings carrying qualifying intent evidence, failing the evidence threshold, or needing a fix disproportionate to a rare trigger, moved out of findings for audit; never shift result or verdict. Omit this key entirely when empty.

severity.description: Severity ranked by likelihood × user impact, or exploitability for security; Low at most for self-recovering, fallback-only, or rerun-cleared defects.

excerpt.description: Quoted code excerpt supporting the finding.

finding.description: One sentence stating the defect, naming sibling sites of a shared root cause.

trigger.description: Trigger scenario, when one exists; omit for a finding suppressed for lacking one.

guidance.description: Advisory fix hints per references/outcome-guide.md ## Guidance; consumers weigh them on their merits, then accept, partially accept, or ignore them.

pattern.description: Existing exemplar to mirror—path:line and symbol.

solution.description: Concrete, targeted fix sketch naming key sites and steps—never vague advice, a diff, or a full patch.

avoid.description: Tempting wrong fix the finding invites—such as a suppression, a masking guard, or a weakened type—with why it fails.

tests.description: Regression test hint: test file to extend, fixtures to reuse, triggering case.

suppressionRationale.description: Quoted intent evidence and its source (commit, PR description, comment, or requester statement), the failed evidence-threshold test (missing, unreachable, implausible, or immaterial trigger), or the fix disproportion, justifying suppression.
